notes.title: v1.4.2 Update log
notes.notes:
Dear survivors, v1.4.2 update drops today!
The game now supports the French and German languages.
We welcome our survivors from the EU to join our fight!

We like to once again thank our survivors for their feedback on Discord and Steam communities.
A Buff interface has now been added so that survivors are aware of their status easily.

We have also designed new chips and made some adjustments to the original chips. This opens up more possibilities for survivors to experiment with different builds.
 
In addition, we also moved some ability cards into the shop to balance the gameplay! 

Get your copy of the game during the Steam Winter Sale from now till the 5th of January 2022, for a major discount of 50%!! 
Grab this rare opportunity and join the survivors with VAR: Exterminate this Christmas holiday!

The following is the complete content of this update. 

[h2]Added language support[/h2]
[list]
[*] French 
[*] German
[/list]

[h2]Buff Interface[/h2]
The various cumulative and time-sensitive abilities brought by the ability cards will be displayed here. Survivors can clearly know the cumulative number of stacks and the remaining time of the Buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/fafc16d57c6ab35dcfac4164c186ad3f182da4e2.gif[/img]
[h2]v1.4.2 Chip List[/h2]

The biochip installed in brains to increase the attack power of the user
[*] Survival Instinct Chip

[*] Energy Chip
The biochip installed in the brain that increases the maximum shield of the wearer
[*] [b]Lucky Chip (Adjusted)[/b]
The biochip installed in the brain that increases the critical chance and critical damage of the wearer.
[/list]
[h3][b]Spine Chips[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]A.M.M.O Chip (New)[/b]
The biochip installed on the spine that increases the ammo capacity.

The biochip installed in the spine increases the number of gold coins earned in a game.
[*] Vampiric Chip
The biochip installed in spines to increase Lifesteal and Lifesteal Chance
[*] [b]Agility Chip (Adjusted)[/b]
The biochip installed in the spine that increase the reload speed of the wearer.
[/list]
[h3][b]Arms Chips[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sniper Chip
The biochip installed in arms to increase Headshot Damage
[*] Spread Chip
The biochip installed in arms to increase Bullet Spread
[*] Bounce Chip
The biochip installed in arms to increase Bounce and Bounce Damage
[*] [b]Nimble Chip (New)[/b]
The biochip mounted on the arm that increases the firing rate of the gun
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Drone Bullet Refinement (Large)
[strike]Drone's Damage +100%[/strike]→
Drone's Damage +75%, Drone's Firing Rate + 75%

[strike]After killing the infected, split 2 bullets to attack the surroundings (cool down 1 second)[/strike]→
After killing the infected, split 3 bullets to attack the surroundings (cool down 1 second)
[/list]
[h3]Ability card moved to the store[/h3]

[/list]

[strike]Club Wielding Giants +150% HP and +50% movement[/strike]→
Club Wielding Giants +150% HP and +50% movement, tenacity to crowd control effects +100%
[/list]
[h3]Fighting Style Deck Changes[/h3]

notes.title: The Mutation 2.0 Update Note
notes.notes:
Dear survivors, version 1.4.0 have been updated today. 
The updated version will include new enemies, new levels, and new shop system! 
After this update, we now officially support Valve Index & welcome more survivors to join us! 
Some adjustments have been made on a few ability cards and fighting style, and gameplay is now more intense than ever. 
Other than new content, we have worked on the optimization of the gameplay, players should expect smoother gameplay. 

The game will be on the Halloween special sales in steam with 33% off discount from 29 October to 2 November, do not miss the chance to have it during this Halloween. 
This Halloween, we have included an exclusive limited-time campaign, during the campaign, survivors can attain Halloween Steam achievements by completing various tasks (from now to before the end of the Halloween sale period). 

Please find the more detailed content of the updates below.

[h1]Mutation Mode Chapter 2[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/237d7ee20cf5195cb9d375562aa799678448a12a.gif[/img]
The second chapter consists of 6 stages, survivors can expect to face the new enemies and use new ability cards in this new chapter. 
Unlock this chapter by collecting 30-45 stars, we welcome all survivors to take on this challenge and fight for the top ranking. 

Next is the introduction of the store system, new enemies, new exterminate cards.


[h1]Shop System[/h1]
Survivors now have more areas to spend the currency earned in missions. You are now able to purchase different levels of ability cards with unique enhancement abilities. 
This shop system will provide survivors more choices in strengthening, it makes survivors easier on building genres and abilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/190405e665b085cdcd0cdf864d8f1fd30e9849d9.gif[/img]
Some selection process of the ability card is replaced by the store system. Survivors can find the shop system in the following levels: 1-Ex, 2-Ex, and all mutation mode levels, the shop system will appear twice when there are more than 20 waves and the shop system will appear only once during stages which last 15 waves.

[b]Products List[/b]
(Click "Show Details" to see full information)
[expand type=details][list]
[*] [h3]Gun maintenance[/h3]
Damage +5%, Firing Rate +5%
[*] [h3]4 Leaf Clover[/h3]
Critical Chance +5%
[*] [h3]Vampiric Fangs[/h3]
Lifesteal Chance +3%, Lifesteal +1%
[*] [h3]Tough guy proof[/h3]
Damage Reduction +5%
[*] [h3]Protein Shake[/h3]
Max HP +15%
[*] [h3]Energy bracelet[/h3]
Max Shield +25%
[*] [h3]Supercharger[/h3]
Shield Restoration Rate +50%
[*] [h3]Bandage[/h3]
Recover 30% HP
[*] [h3]Gambler's Cocktail[/h3]
Recover 1% of max HP upon critical strike, cool down for 2 seconds
[*] [h3]Vampire's Heart[/h3]
Lifesteal effect heals an additional 2% of max hp. Cool down for 2 seconds
[*] [h3]Adrenaline[/h3]
After taking damage, attack power +20% for 3 seconds
[*] [h3]Choke[/h3]
Bullet Spread Angle -20%
[*] [h3]50. Cal Bullet[/h3]
Bullet Speed +35%
[*] [h3]Double nutrition[/h3]
All healing effects increased by 5%
[*] [h3]Assasin's Memoir[/h3]
Torso Damage +2% for every kill, stacks infinitely and returns to 0 at the end of the wave
[*] [h3]Revive Token[/h3]
Resurrect once (full HP and shield), and knock back the surrounding enemies by 2 meters
[/list][/expand]

[h1]New Enemies[/h1]
There are 4 brands new enemies that will appear in mutation mode chapter 2. 
These enemies spawn anywhere and will surprise the survivors. When paired with a mutation card, they will be even stronger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/78e5c4ec863ecdf482c30e8aaaae415d56b32c77.gif[/img]
For a detailed list of new enemies, please refer to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1578960/announcements/detail/3042737430862716584]this survivor log.[/url]。
[b]New Enemies List[/b]
(Click "Show Details" to see full information)
[expand type=details][list]
[*] [h3]Pyro[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/93d18b199fb3d47de38817f3a91ad1678763fac8.png[/img]
The highly aggressive special infected zombies spit flames, leaving survivors no space to breathe!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/78119325a1319c342d8c7670cec2e01a2910d2cb.gif[/img]
[*] [h3]Infector[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/041096a57817a17d7382db39767102d971a07622.png[/img]
The aggressiveness is as intense as PYRO, but the acid attack will cause continuous damage to survivors!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/52ed95f8389162720dd25cb537ca57fdf5d131e3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/1971a74468216ccddde1f7da49ab71323a73417e.gif[/img]
[/list]
[/expand]

[h1]New Mutation Cards[/h1]
Beyond the existing mutations cards, there will be new mutation cards that appear in chapter 2. Survivors, ready yourself and face enemies more fearsome than ever. (Or will you continue to be a coward?)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/ab90acc2aedc1cbc843a4d934ede057068470a99.gif[/img]
[b]New Mutation Cards List[/b]
(Click "Show Details" to see full information)
[expand type=details]

The number of zombies summoned by the Howler is doubled

[*] [h3]BAM BAM[/h3]

Additional scores: +10%
[*] [h3]Titan[/h3]
MEGA boss gets an upgrade!
Increased HP, Movement and Attack Speed +30%
Additional scores: +30%
[*] [h3]Tower shield[/h3]
The size of shield enemies wield increases by 20%
Additional scores: +10%
[/list]
[/expand]

[h1]Content of the Halloween exclusive limited-time campaign[/h1]
[h2]Halloween Steam Achievement[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Trick or Treat[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/2895090c3bb003bed819a83ffc7d0e5b938ec86f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/7f301a2773931e54fef6df7119812c6bc10f611d.png[/img][/url]
Choose Pumpkin juice card
[*] [h3]Out With It[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/1527bce7c341771ac93cddee2f4f93dd2b454b9b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/94e89a5af3bced5b7e4c1f17cf64a5322eb3724d.png[/img][/url]
Choose Pumpkin pie card
[/list]
[h2]Halloween special edition ability cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Pumpkin Pie[/h3]
Max HP +15%, Recover 50% HP
Rarity: Rare
[/list]
[h2]Halloween special edition shop products[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Pumpkin juice[/h3]
Recover 30% HP
[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[h2]Ability Cards Changes[/h2]
(Click "Show Details" to see full information)
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [h3]Evolution (Damage)[/h3]
[strike]Damage +5% for every 15 enemies killed (maximum stack: 6 times)[/strike]
↓
Damage +5% for every 20 enemies killed (maximum stack: 6 times)
[*] [h3]Death Splinter[/h3]
[strike]30% chance to split 2 bullets to its surroundings upon killing[/strike]
↓
After killing the infected, split 2 bullets to attack the surroundings (cool down 1 seconds)
[*] [h3]Shock Wave[/h3]
[strike]10% chance to knock back enemies by 2 meters upon hitting[/strike]
↓
When hitting an enemy, knock back the target by 2 meters (cool down 2 seconds)
[*] [h3]Awareness[/h3]
[strike]Temporarily increase Firing Rate by +50% for 10 seconds after taking damage[/strike]
↓
Temporarily increase Firing Rate by +50% for 5 seconds after taking damage
[*] [h3]HP Attack[/h3]
[strike]Deal an extra damage base on 15% current HP per hit[/strike]
↓
Deal an extra damage base on 12% current HP per hit
[*] [h3]Headstart[/h3]
[strike]Damage +30% for 20 seconds after every wave start[/strike]
↓
Damage +40% for 20 seconds after every wave start
[*] [h3]Sticky Bullets[/h3]
[strike]Inflict slow upon critical hit (reduce movement speed for 50% for 3 seconds)[/strike]
↓
Hitting the enemy's leg slows them down (50% slow for 3 seconds, Cool down 0 second)
[*] [h3]Combo Hunter Healing[/h3]
[strike]Recover 5% HP for every 15 combo[/strike]
↓
Every 15 Combo restores 2% HP and 2% Shield
[*] [h3]Berserker[/h3]
[strike]Damage +50% when current HP is less than 35%[/strike]
↓
Firing Rate +50% when current HP is less than 50%
[*] [h3]Final showdown[/h3]
[strike]The last bullet of magazine deals 3X damage[/strike]
↓
The last bullet of magazine deals 5X damage
[*] [h3]Mental Fortitude[/h3]
[strike]Damage Reduction +25% when current HP is less than 50%[/strike]
↓
Damage Reduction +30% when current HP is less than 50%
[*] [h3]Blood Pact[/h3]
[strike]Damage +75%, -10% HP per attack (will not cause death)[/strike]
↓
Damage +75%, -2% HP per attack (will not cause death)
[*] [h3]Imperfection[/h3]
[strike]Max HP +80%, Damage Reduction -10%[/strike]
↓
Max HP +80%, Damage Reduction -20%
[/list]
[/expand]
[h2]Ability Cards Removal[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steady Hands
[*] Revive Token (move to the shop system)
[/list]
[h2]Levels Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shop parts in the mutation mode chapter 1, 1-Ex and 2-Ex  (replaced 1-2 times the part of the selecting of the ability card)
[/list]
[h2]Fighting Style Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Cryogenics[/h3]
[strike]Causes a frost explosion upon hitting a frozen enemy. Dealing 200% damage and freezing enemies within a 3-meter radius (Cooldown: 2s)[/strike]
↓
An ice storm is generated when hitting a frozen enemy, dealing 200% damage and freezing enemies within a radius of 3 meters for 3 seconds. (cool down 3 seconds)
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/fbc4b6c3cdfcb259fdc0b6c7e55f324d3c688a5f.gif[/img]

[h1]Performance Changes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Game engine upgraded to Unity2019 version, which will have lots of positive effects on game performance.
[*] Adjust parts of the game logic, which reduces the burden of the CPU.
[*] Optimize parts of the graphics, which to reduce graphical lag.
[/olist]
[h1]Valve Index support[/h1]
[b]The operations method of the Index:[/b]
[list]
[*] Trigger-shooting, operation UI interface
[*] Button A – Reload
[*] Button B – Pause the game during stages
[/list]

[h1]Adjustment of the game control[/h1]
We would like to thank all our loyal survivors who have given valuable feedback and discussion in our Discord server. We revised the reload mechanism to a simpler automatic method.
Reload now happens automatically once the magazine is empty.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Adjustments on the sound effect
[/olist]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed the bug in the reconfirmation interface when players give up on the mission, you can still press the game setting and the button of the return to mission.
[*] Fixed the bug in the sound effect of the chainsaw when starting the game.
[/olist]

Thank you for being a huge part to VAR: Exterminate, please feel free to comment or message us with the link below, or join [url=https://discord.com/invite/chp6YZEmRp]our Discord[/url] to discuss with other players and developers.


Thanks to the community, especially HDfromDadsGameToo, Bok3Ron for helping with the new content production! We're very grateful.

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: "Fighting Styles" Update Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/77c72fd580995dc009f3ec469dcc5015691049a2.png[/img]
Dear Survivors, Update v1.3.0 version is live!
We have received feedback about the randomness of the upgrade cards. In order to alleviate the situation of not being able to draw the desired ability cards, we have designed a Fighting Style system.

With the new Fighting Style system, Survivors can easily build your favorite style to fight against these crazed zombies.

In addition to the Fighting Style System, an ability card database has also been added to the main page, allowing survivors to easily check various abilities.

Without further ado, let's take a look at the introduction of combat style and ability card database!

[h1]Fighting Styles[/h1]
Fighting styles are part of the equipment system, equip your favorite style and explore the possibilities.

Each fighting style has a unique core ability and its own style deck.
In each level, you have 1-2 chances to draw ability cards from the style deck, making it easier to accumulate abilities for that style.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/0594d03369d4b57b20aa6dc0f739621c237c7289.gif[/img]
Each fighting style has its own proficiency gauge. Gain proficiency tokens by filling the gauge which can be used to unlock more fighting styles. Gauge can be filled by completing stages. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/1c49949a3815ad50c8b812b30e6371d6afe49f0c.gif[/img]
For a detailed list of styles, click "Show Details" below.

Survival is key, increase your max HP and live to tell the tale.

Shields have the same characteristics as HP. Any damage taken will be fully absorbed by the shield before receiving damage to HP. Shield has a base regeneration rate of 3% per second after 10 seconds of taking no damage.

notes.title: The Mutation Update Note
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/42dae6efa4025b36ff211081674d968e7b5557e3.png[/img]
Congratulations to all survivors for making it this far!
Prepare yourselves, for we are returning to the city to face our greatest challenge yet!

[h1]Mutation Mode[/h1]
Survivors get to choose 1 out of 3 mutations to apply on zombies. Beware, each choice may drastically affect your destiny

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/3105e4d2643a40ac56b3079524d8f08876a36a4f.gif[/img]

Mutations not only changes the zombies abilities but also affect their behavioral patterns. To our foolhardy survivors. Are you ready to take on what is ahead?


[h1]Mutation Levels[/h1]
6 mutation levels added.
Following our previous log, 3 new types of enemies have been spotted lurking around the mutated zones. Codenamed: [Bulwark], [Marauder] & [Brigandier].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40450994/29791c439e7f88914f72ab82b83dc248df68aad8.gif[/img]

[h1]Ability Card Review Function[/h1]
Improvements in the review function: Survivors can now hover on the abilities chosen for a detailed description in the Pause Menu.

notes.title: Update Notes for June 7
notes.notes:
Greetings survivors!
Introducing the whole new status mechanism, in this update we will be introducing various abnormal status and boost status, providing players with more options and strategies to fend off hordes of zombies! 

From our statistical data, we observed the use of cards by survivors and adjusted the effects of some cards, hoping to greatly improve the practicability of the cards.
VAR: Exterminate will bring more updates to the survivors in the future. Please continue to follow us and give us more feedback and suggestions so that the game can continue to improve and become better!
The following is the content of this update. 

[h1]New Equipment[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h3]Tactical Drone[/h3]
Slot: Drone
Inflict slow upon hit (reduce movement speed by 50% for 3 seconds)
Skill: Launch a frost grenade, inflicting freeze within 3.5 meters radius (stop all movements for 1.5 seconds). Basic cooldown by 30 seconds.

[*] [h3]Steel Armor[/h3]
Slot: Armor
A steel armor that can effectively resist the attacks of zombies.
Increase HP and damage reduction for player.
[/list]


[h1]New Ability Cards[/h1]

Inflict bleeding upon critical hit (Deal 200% damage over 5 seconds, +20% damage taken during bleeding)

50% chance to inflict bleeding upon headshot (Deal 200% damage over 5 seconds, +20% damage taken during bleeding)

Rarity: Common (white)

Rarity: Common (white)

Rarity: Epic (purple)

[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for May 30
notes.notes:
[h1]Brand new Systems[/h1]
[h3]Status effect system[/h3]
A new status effect system has already been implemented.

Our team has been investigated how cards can affect combats, we found out that current ability cards can only improve the players' raw stats, but for actual combats, we don't want to provide ability cards to just power up stats but more diversity to the players for strategic uses to utilize such as Frozen, Slow, Knockback, etc.

This system needs to be developed based on these statements. We believe this system can give the players more strategic options to play with, and think about more combinations to look for. 

In addition to that, more extensions based on this system will be updated in the future, for example, new equipment, new cards, new drones, and new abilities for classes, etc.

Check the new ability cards below to check out our first update for this brand new system.


[h1]Ability Cards Added[/h1]
[h3]Sticky Bullets[/h3]
Inflict slow upon critical hit (reduce movement speed for 50% for 3 seconds)

[h3]Gambler's Spirit[/h3]
Critical Chance +2% for every attack that isn't a critical hit, this effect will reset on critical hit

[h3]Twist Of Fate[/h3]
Optional cards amount -1
Damage +5%  on the start of each waves

[h3]Carcass Swamp[/h3]
30% chance to inflict slow in a large radius upon killing

[h3]Frozen Chamber[/h3]
Inflict freeze for every 7 combo (stop all movements for 1.5 seconds)

[h3]Frost Module[/h3]
Drone has 7% chance to inflict freeze upon hit (stop all movements for 1.5 seconds)


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
Changed the cards that can be drawn in 1-3, 2-1, 2-2.
